## What this note teaches

One or two sentences. What will the next person do differently after reading it?

## Provenance

- [ ] A scar: this happened, cost more than an hour, and the cause was not where I first looked
- [ ] A survey or snapshot of a fast-moving ecosystem (marked "re-verify" at the top of the note)
- [ ] Vendor facts checked against the vendor's own current page or repository, with the date

## Checklist

- [ ] Symptom → cause → fix → why it was hard to find (for scars)
- [ ] No credentials, real hostnames, client names, or internal links
- [ ] Linked from `README.md` (routing table and full index) and from any note it extends
- [ ] One subject per PR; README rows appended at the end of their table
- [ ] Committed as the human author, no agent co-author trailers
